messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Beta yeh mahine ki tuition fee teacher ko de dena kal, main bahar hoon.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Ji Abbu, 5,000 hai na? Main shaam ko de kar receipt le aaunga.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Haan beta shukriya. Teacher ko mera salam kehna.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Zaroor Abbu. Kuch aur kaam yaad dila dein?
